items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: The funny thing is, I played on Bobby Jones’ show when I was in eleventh grade.

ctx.x: Bobby Jones’s going to do it first.

Right. The funny thing is, I played on Bobby Jones’ show when I was in eleventh grade. Didn’t Bobby Jones get canceled? I think he’s off the air now. This is the last year. Yeah, I played with a choir on there when I was in high school. I’ll never forget that.
Now by the way, you may have noticed you don’t hear yourself in the mic. Just go right ahead.
